description:
Truck parking list

Returns an overview of all truck parking locations in the Netherlands with
current occupancy information. Static location data is combined with dynamic
occupancy status (DATEX II). Optionally paginate with `page` (plus `per_page`,
max 500; only then does the response contain a `meta` block). Filter by status,
availability or road.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: ndw.truckparking
